articles.headline: Ambani's Jio IPO oversubscribed within hours in record sale
articles.brief: Reliance's Jio IPO achieved record-breaking oversubscription within hours, pushing bids past Rs 50,000 crore and strengthening the Indian rupee to a six-week high.

articles.headline: Indian non-bank lenders flag gold loan stress
articles.brief: Top Indian non-bank financial institutions have highlighted early indicators of financial stress emerging within their portfolios of loans secured against gold.

articles.headline: Half of India's coal plants run critically low on fuel
articles.brief: Roughly half of India's coal-fired power plants are operating with critically depleted fuel reserves as surging electricity demand strains national energy supplies.

articles.headline: Essar gets nod for Rs 2,276 cr Kandla terminal
articles.brief: Essar Ports has received official approval to develop a massive multipurpose cargo terminal at Kandla, involving an investment of Rs 2,276 crore.

articles.headline: Eight web security keys of eMudhra leaked
articles.brief: Web security keys belonging to eMudhra—a firm whose digital certificates are utilized by key government portals including UIDAI—have been leaked online.

articles.headline: State Bank of India reports customer data breach
articles.brief: State Bank of India confirmed a minor cyberattack that compromised roughly 3,900 customer records, prompting immediate internal security reviews.

articles.headline: Delhi enforces GRAP-1 curbs as air quality drops
articles.brief: Authorities in Delhi-NCR invoked Stage-I restrictions under the Graded Response Action Plan after the regional Air Quality Index deteriorated into the 'poor' category.

articles.headline: Haridwar's Har Ki Pauri goes dry amid pilgrimage
articles.brief: Portions of the holy Har Ki Pauri ghat in Haridwar have gone dry, forcing pilgrims to rely on small vessels to complete ritual bathing traditions.

articles.headline: UN experts urge India to halt excessive protest force
articles.brief: United Nations human rights experts have formally called upon Indian authorities to immediately cease the use of excessive force in handling public demonstrations.

articles.headline: Samajwadi Party dissolves entire Kannauj district unit
articles.brief: The Akhilesh Yadav-led Samajwadi Party dissolved its Kannauj district committee following a party rally that failed to meet expected attendance targets ahead of polls.

articles.headline: India passes 50 medals at Asian Para Games
articles.brief: Indian athletes surpassed the fifty-medal milestone at the Asian Para Games, highlighted by impressive gold-winning sprint performances by Simran and Dilip Gavit.

articles.headline: Inequality drives non-communicable disease impact: WHO
articles.brief: A new World Health Organization report emphasizes that social marginalization, economic inequality, and migrant statuses heavily exacerbate the burden of non-communicable diseases.

articles.headline: Kenya cult leader convicted of 190 starvation deaths
articles.brief: A Kenyan court convicted cult leader Paul Mackenzie of murdering 190 children and adults who starved themselves following instructions to meet Jesus.

articles.headline: Iran rules out sending enriched uranium abroad
articles.brief: Iranian Supreme National Security Council Secretary Mohsen Rezaei rejected any proposals requiring Iran to transfer its enriched nuclear material to foreign nations.
